# Image toolchain for CPython 3.12 on the Ubuntu Actions runner.
# Pin transitive dependencies too; install with --only-binary=:all: so CI
# never silently falls back to compiling a legacy graphics stack.
# ReportLab 3.6.x has no CPython 3.12 wheels. ReportLab 4 separates its bitmap
# backend: rl-renderPM supplies _renderPM, selected explicitly by our helper.

CairoSVG==2.9.1
cffi==2.1.1
charset-normalizer==3.5.2
cssselect2==0.10.1
defusedxml==0.7.1
lxml==6.1.3
pillow==12.3.0
pycparser==3.11
reportlab==4.5.1
rl-renderPM==4.0.3
svglib==2.3.0
tinycss2==1.5.1
webencodings==0.6.1
